title: rahulnyk/knowledge_graph: turn unstructured text into a graph for retrieval and Q&A
friendlyTitle: This project turns text into a knowledge graph
summary: This project converts text into a knowledge graph that can support graph-augmented generation and knowledge-graph question answering. It offers a practical example of extracting entities and relationships before retrieval.
friendlySummary: It finds important things and relationships in text, then stores them as a graph for AI search and questions.
whyItMatters: Use it as a learning project or starting point when ordinary chunk retrieval loses important relationships across documents. Its visual graph output can also help people inspect what the extraction pipeline believes the source material contains.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can help when simple document search misses connections. The graph also makes it easier to inspect what the AI extracted.
